botTyping.intro: Hey! I'm going to walk you through registration — one step at a time.
botTyping.question2: First things first — how do you want to sign up?
botTyping.question4: Choose a password — make it a good one.
botTyping.question5: Type your password again to confirm.
botTyping.question6: Tell us a bit about yourself.
botTyping.question7: Last one — what's your phone number?

botErrors.emailInvalid: Hmm, that doesn't look like a valid email — double-check and try again.
botErrors.passwordTooShort: Your password needs at least 8 characters. Make it stronger!
botErrors.passwordMismatch: Those passwords don't match — give it another shot.
botErrors.phoneInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid phone number. Try: +33 6 12 34 56 78
botErrors.aboutTooShort: Tell us a bit more — at least a few words.
botErrors.fieldRequired: Don't leave this blank — I need this one!
